items.text:
I'm giving a positive vote for now. The game concept is beautiful, nevertheless is not a polished game so expect some bugs. I played something like 20 hours straight, but I see they need to implement like a TON of things like air scrubber, pump to recover gasses, processes to refill stuff, quick transfer between inventories, more bases around the system (only one is functional at the moment) (as I said ton of stuff).
I'm in love with the game concept. I think they need to speed up the process as well to focus on marketing to reach more potential players if they want to refine this gem.
items.text_zh:
我暂时投赞成票。游戏概念很美，但它还不是一款打磨完善的游戏，所以预计会有一些bug。我连续玩了大约20个小时，但我看到他们需要实现一大堆东西，比如空气洗涤器、回收气体的泵、补充物资的流程、库存之间的快速转移、星系中更多的基地（目前只有一个能正常运作）（正如我所说，一大堆东西）。
我爱上了这个游戏概念。我认为他们也需要加快进程，同时专注于营销以触达更多潜在玩家，如果他们想完善这颗宝石的话。

observations.description: 缺少库存间快速转移功能
observations.evidence_zh: 物品栏之间的快速转移
